newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO SHARES TRADE ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET.
newsitem.headline: NO SHARES TRADE ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Thursday's 41.14 points as no company shares traded on the local stock market for a seventh day in a row, brokers said.

Razvitie Investment Fund's third issue stocks were offered at 35 levs against par of 100 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there were no bidders. Central Cooperative Bank shares were also offered there at par of 1,000 but they attracted no bids.
Varna Grand Hotel shares were bid at 85 levs on the BSE, still below par of 100 but no one offered.
No corporate stocks traded on Sofia Stock Exchange either where a seven-day repo deal in treasury paper worth of 1.323 million levs was struck, yielding 1.90 percent until repurchase, said brokers.
